name: Raene Wolfrunner
summary: In Astranaar, Raene Wolfrunner directs the Sentinels as Ashenvale faces threats from the Horde and corrupted furbolg tribes. Korra, her saber cat, and Dagri, her wolf, remain close at hand.

sections.title: Defender of Astranaar
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner keeps watch in Astranaar with Korra, her saber cat, and Dagri, her wolf. As a Sentinel officer, she oversees patrols throughout Ashenvale and gathers intelligence from beyond the forest. She sends scouts such as Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions, including the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: Stemming the Forest's Corruption
sections.body: Raene works to halt the corruption spreading among Ashenvale’s native denizens. She directs campaigns against hostile furbolg tribes, including strikes on Foulweald camps that harass travelers and efforts to remove rising Thistlefur leaders. Her scouts watch for changes in furbolg behavior. Under her command, they guard local settlements and passing travelers against coordinated ambushes.

sections.title: Dartol's Rod
sections.body:
Dartol’s Rod is an ancient relic tied to the purification of furbolgs, and Raene has made finding it her cause. Her longtime friend Teronis was slain while seeking its missing gemstone. Raene ordered his body recovered and pledged to finish his research. With the dryad Shael'dryn, she helps champions assemble the relic.

Dartol’s Rod lets an adventurer take furbolg guise and speak with chieftain Krolg. That opens the way to defeat the tainted leader Ran Bloodtooth and purge the regional threat.

faq.q: Where can Raene Wolfrunner be found?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner can be found outdoors in Astranaar, Ashenvale’s central night elf town. Her two animal companions stand beside her.

faq.q: Who are the animals standing next to Raene?
faq.answer: Raene’s companions are Korra, a saber cat, and Dagri, a wolf. Both stay beside her in Astranaar.

faq.q: What is Raene's role within the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Raene is a ranking Sentinel officer in central Ashenvale. She orders scouts, manages outposts, and coordinates operations against local threats.

faq.q: What happened to Raene's friend Teronis?
faq.answer: Teronis was seeking a gemstone for Dartol’s Rod when he was slain in the field. Raene arranged for his remains to be recovered and pledged to complete his research.

faq.q: Why is Raene focusing so heavily on the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Corrupted furbolg tribes such as the Foulweald and Thistlefur have grown more aggressive. They ambush travelers on forest roads and threaten Astranaar’s stability.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Dartol's Rod in her questline?
faq.answer: Dartol’s Rod lets an adventurer take furbolg form and speak with Krolg. This opens the way to confront the corrupt chieftain Ran Bloodtooth.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers from Darkshore, Raene coordinates Ashenvale’s military and ecological defense.
As a night elf, you can see Raene’s devotion to Elune and Kalimdor’s wilderness in her defense of Ashenvale’s woodland sanctuaries.
As a hunter, you may recognize Raene’s mastery of the wilderness and her bond with beasts. She commands a wolf and a saber cat.
